title_zh: 2025 KET 校园版真题 3 · 第 1 套 · 阅读 Part 1（B3T1）
source_label: 个人教研使用 · Cambridge KET 真题 3 Test 1 Part 1

items.question: The club wants to find people who
options: like playing a variety of games.
are interested in trying something new.
have experience of playing computer chess.
items.correct_answer: are interested in trying something new.
items.explanation_zh: 告示针对厌倦电脑游戏、想换爱好的人，国际象棋俱乐部属于「尝试新事物」。

prompt.message: Have you got an extra T-shirt I can borrow for gym class? I've forgotten mine and it's too late to go back home.

items.question: Why has Tilda sent this message?
options: to find out if Zoe is able to lend her something
to ask if Zoe can collect something from the gym
to check if Zoe has remembered to bring the right sports kit
items.correct_answer: to find out if Zoe is able to lend her something
items.explanation_zh: 核心信息是 forgotten mine 与 borrow an extra T-shirt，意在借一件运动衫。

prompt.headline: BREAD ISN'T GOOD FOR DUCKS!
prompt.subline: Bird food available at visitor centre £1 per bag

items.question: What is this sign saying?
options: Bird food costs less at the visitor centre than at other places.
The visitor centre wants more people to give food to the ducks.
Visitors must be careful about the kind of food they give to the ducks.
items.correct_answer: Visitors must be careful about the kind of food they give to the ducks.
items.explanation_zh: 告示强调面包不宜喂鸭，应使用游客中心出售的专用鸟食。

prompt.body: Sorry to hear you're not well. If you aren't able to play in the big match next week, let me know soon.

items.question: What is Ms Wilson saying to Josh?
options: I'm afraid I haven't decided if you can take part in the competition yet.
It's a shame you missed the last match, but I'm glad you're feeling better.
You must contact me if your health doesn't improve over the next few days.
items.correct_answer: You must contact me if your health doesn't improve over the next few days.
items.explanation_zh: 邮件要求若下周大赛无法出场须尽快告知。

prompt.message: The 4 p.m. bus is delayed and won't arrive for another hour. If I can't get a lift with anyone, I'll walk home.

items.question: Why has Eric sent his mum this message?
options: to explain why he missed the bus
to tell her his plans for getting home
to find out if she can give him a lift
items.correct_answer: to tell her his plans for getting home
items.explanation_zh: 说明公交延误及可能步行回家，属于告知回家安排。

prompt.subject: Theatre trip
prompt.body: Anyone who's already on the list for this trip but hasn't paid, please give me £15.00 by 3 p.m.

items.question: What is this email saying?
options: There are a few spaces left if anyone wants to go on the trip.
If you've got a place on the trip, you need to pay today.
Students who have paid for the trip should come to a meeting at 3 p.m.
items.correct_answer: If you've got a place on the trip, you need to pay today.
items.explanation_zh: 已在名单但未付款者须在下午 3 点前缴费。
